name: The Voldemort Reversal
claim: We expected parties to stop naming the opposing president — a Voldemort effect. The archive says the opposite: across Obama, Trump, and Biden, the out-party names the president MORE, while the in-party is the one that reaches for euphemism ("the administration," "the White House") for its own. Opposing-minus-own euphemism avoidance is negative for both parties. Association only; the measure is word choice in official press releases, not intent.

numbers.metric: opp-minus-own euphemism-avoidance = (euphemism share for the opposing president) minus (euphemism share for the party's own president), per party
numbers.unit: share of president-references that are euphemistic (per-1k-statements basis)
numbers.direction: negative for both parties (opposite of the pre-registered CONFIRM direction)
numbers.preregistered_confirm_threshold: euphemism (avoidance) share >= 10pp higher for opposing than own president, BOTH parties, BOTH halves

confounds_tested: coverage/symmetry -> only presidencies with both-party press-lane data used (Obama, Trump, Biden); Bush excluded (press lane ~100% D pre-2009, no symmetric R baseline)
both-parties gate -> the negative direction holds for BOTH party A and party B, not one side driving it
list pre-registration -> the euphemism set was fixed before the run (presidents.json), so the reversal is not a post-hoc list choice
name-vs-euphemism basis -> measured as rate per 1k statements to remove volume asymmetry between parties/years
split_result: Consistent across all three presidencies carrying both-party data (Obama, Trump, Biden) — a stable direction, not a single-presidency artifact. The pre-registered split (halves + each both-party presidency) fails in the CONFIRM direction and passes in the reversed direction.
chart_spec: Diverging bar of opp-minus-own euphemism avoidance per party (both bars land below zero, A -0.033 / B -0.058). Companion small-multiples: for each presidency, own-president vs opposing-president euphemism share, showing the in-party bar sitting higher (more euphemism) in every case.
receipts_note: Receipts pull from text_features.jsonl (675k statements): out-party statements naming the president by name (e.g. 'President Trump' / 'President Obama' tokens) vs in-party 'the administration' / 'the White House' euphemism usages, each expandable to member + date + URL at publish time.
republication_note: Refuted-then-reversed: the pre-registered hypothesis (parties avoid naming the opposing president) is REFUTED, and the found direction (the out-party names the president more; the in-party euphemizes its own) is a reversal candidate. It must be re-pre-registered in the found direction and re-run before publishing.
